name: Purwakarta

queries.query: Purwakarta Indonesia official land parcel cadastral map ATR BPN GIS peta bidang tanah
queries.scope: Identify current first-party local registry/cadastre and safe public parcel geometry.
queries.result: BHUMI is the official ATR/BPN interactive land-information map integrated with the ministry’s ATLAS spatial data platform. The local Purwakarta government SI-DIKA map is first-party but the visible catalog is administrative boundaries and irrigation assets, not parcel polygons. Dynamic BHUMI content did not expose a Purwakarta-specific safe anonymous feature query or stable parcel ID/geometry in this review.
queries.executionMethod: Separate English-language web search followed by first-party page review.

queries.query: Peta bidang tanah Purwakarta ATR BPN BHUMI resmi Kantor Pertanahan Kabupaten Purwakarta
queries.scope: Find first-party local-language registry, cadastral map or land-service evidence, and confirm locality.
queries.result: The national ATR/BPN is the official land registry authority; Purwakarta Regency’s official government reports local ATR/BPN land-office PTSL registration activity. BHUMI is an official interactive land-information map. However, the local SI-DIKA catalog exposed boundaries and irrigation data rather than parcel polygons, and the WUP-point layer/coverage remains unresolved.
